provenance.scope: W113 canonical six-job basic roster and weapon requirements. Frozen campaigns retain their own toolbar rows; the loader fills only omitted weapon classes from this roster.

source.evidence: Shipped locale Global.Text.20217 = Lightning Strike, 420252 = Sweeping Slash, 17071 = Zap; weapon names 131975, 13699, 11056. Resources/Images/Images.txt rows 10898, 10189, 10519 confirm icon ids 14813, 14104, 14434. Resources/WieldTypeAnimationMappings.txt rows 11, 14, 12 map Ninja/Warrior/Wizard wield types 9/12/10 to swing group 1099. Ability-definition reader 00a32930 and lookup/request 00a34d10 consume server-supplied ids; no original job ability id is recovered here.

Sanctuary 4f028dcc274f628b65ef665fd59b184f5f3d3e3e Resources/CombatJobs.json profiles 2,32,12 and CombatAbilities.json rows 2154,5011,4011 supply the starter/name/icon bindings and definition_id 4895. Those combat row ids are community keys, not retail ids. https://github.com/Open-Source-Free-Realms/Sanctuary (AGPL-3.0); data reference only, no source code copied.

FreeRealms-Legacy 9e082025391177d5a33ee18c714ddd06b457a695 src/Resources/ClientItemDefinitions.json items 75091 (Ninja), 29963 (Warrior), 4914 (Wizard) supply weapon_name_id. https://github.com/raisingkaines/FreeRealms-Legacy (AGPL-3.0); weapon-to-ability bindings remain reference evidence. W82 owns starter inventory/equipment delivery.

(R) Reuse the existing basic slot 0, zero-cost immediate single-target strike and definition id 4895. Runtime encounter.rs already sets Ninja 3m/100, Warrior 3m/110, Wizard 20m/130, 600ms repeat gate, and damage x1.75^(tier-1) at levels 1/4/5/8/12. No balance, AoE, projectile, weapon enforcement or timing code is added. Original ids, clip duration, range, recast and historical damage are not recovered.

(R) Every supported combat basic and job skill requires its job weapon in slot 7; no weapon-free exemptions. Missing legacy basic requirements inherit this roster; missing skill requirements inherit the basic when loaded. Item class -> wield mapping is Sanctuary Resources/ItemClasses.txt lines 7,11,18,19,28,72 (reference data), matching client WieldTypeAnimationMappings.txt lines 11-16. Native 008e3760 reads item Class/Slot at definition offsets 32/40. AbilityDefinition 00a32930 has no recovered per-skill weapon-class field; no exact weapon refusal string recovered from 009cf430 or locale search. Weapon names/icons are display metadata, never an authorization test. This supersedes W85 no-enforcement statement.
